label: Spodumene concentrate (Atlas estimate)
n: Atlas estimate: spodumene concentrate has no customs code of its own; the atlas reads it from HS 253090 ('mineral substances not elsewhere specified', CEPII BACI customs data, gross weight), keeping only the rows from Australia, Zimbabwe and Brazil to China, the exporters for which a page read by the atlas says that they ship lithium concentrate to China (the pages are listed on the lithium page). These rows may still hold other minerals. Not read as spodumene before 2021: Australia's statistics office created the national subheading 25309011 'Lithium concentrates' in January 2021 (Australian Bureau of Statistics, Insights into Australian Exports of Lithium, 4 August 2022); no page read says what HS 253090 from these exporters held before
